prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
I implemented the fix in `cron.py`.

What it now does:
- Parses all 5 fields with support for `*`, numbers, lists, ranges, and steps (`*/15`, `10-40/10`, `n/step`).
- Validates ranges and values, raising `ValueError` for malformed expressions.
- Handles day-of-week `0-6` with Sunday `= 0`, plus `7` as Sunday.
- Applies the Vixie-cron rule: when both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted, either may match; otherwise the restricted field controls.
- Starts strictly after `after` with seconds/microseconds dropped, and searches across month/year rollovers and leap days for up to 5 years before raising `ValueError`.

Verified with targeted cases, 300 randomized brute-force comparisons, Vixie OR-rule semantics, invalid expressions, impossible dates, and leap-year/month-year rollovers.
